subject: Admin activity evidence: sensitivity tagging, redaction map & export delivery options
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <security@greenbridge.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@greenbridge.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: admin activity evidence + sensitivity tagging map

Hi Rachel,

As part of GreenBridge's SOC 2 readiness work we're collecting evidence for admin activity and operator logs. Specifically we need: 1) a short inventory of what admin actions are recorded (user auth, role grants, console/API changes, SSH/job lifecycle, model pinning, billing/admin API calls), 2) your default retention windows by event class, 3) options for redaction or sensitivity tagging (PII/PHI flags) at export time, and 4) your preferred handoff methods (SFTP with signed manifest vs HTTPS pull vs signed Drive link).

Can you attach an example manifest and a small sample (sanitized) export or tell us the export formats you support? GreenBridge also needs chain-of-custody checksums and KMS key IDs used for encrypting the bundle.

Thanks — can we get this by EOD Wednesday (2027-04-21) so our internal audit team can triage?

Elena Martinez
Security & Compliance Manager
GreenBridge Therapeutics

---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <security@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity evidence + sensitivity tagging map

Hi Elena,

Thanks — summary below and an initial handoff plan. Short answers first: we log the items you listed, retention is configurable per-tenant but defaults are 365 days for admin actions and 90 days for session/trace events, export formats supported: newline-delimited JSON (jsonl) and Parquet with an attached manifest (SHA256 checksums). We support SFTP drop with signed manifest, HTTPS pull with short-lived signed URL, and an encrypted Drive share with signed manifest. KMS key IDs will be provided in the manifest.

What we will deliver by Wed: (1) sensitivity_map_v1.csv (columns: event_type, pii_flag, redaction_level), (2) a 24-hour sanitized sample in jsonl, (3) admin_activity_manifest.tar.gz (includes manifest.json, checksums, kms_ref.txt).

Notes and choices you should confirm:
- Redaction granularity: we can redact fields (masking) or drop entire events for PII/PHI. Masking preserves event shape for forensic reconstruction but requires acceptance from your privacy team.
- Sampling vs full export: full exports for SOC 2 are heavier; if you need a full window we recommend SFTP + manifest. For quick review we can provide a sampled jsonl via HTTPS.
- Preservation for legal hold: we can stop automatic deletion on a per-tenant legal hold flag and keep exports immutable for the hold duration.

Kimberly / Ben — can you confirm: 1) earliest window to create the sample export (we'll need a 24h job), 2) whether we have a baked-in sensitivity-tag pipeline (I think yes — Ben, details?), and 3) SFTP user + ACL to provision for GreenBridge?

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: sensitivity_map_v1.csv (CSV), export_sample_sanitzed.jsonl (jsonl - sample), admin_activity_manifest.tar.gz (tgz - manifest + checksums)

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T14:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity evidence + sensitivity tagging map

Rachel / Kimberly — quick update on feasibility and ops timeline.

1) Sensitivity tagging: we have an event enrichment pipeline that annotates events with sensitivity tags at ingest (sensitivity: NONE/LOW/PII/PHI). The pipeline outputs both a tag field and an obfuscated copy for sensitive fields (configurable). I'll attach the internal mapping and the transform script reference.
2) Export readiness: we can produce a jsonl or Parquet export for any tenant window up to 90 days in a single job. For larger windows we chunk and stream to the SFTP target.
3) Chain-of-custody: exports are packaged, signed (GPG) and checksummed; we provide both SHA256 and a signed manifest; KMS wrapping is via our customer key in CloudKMS (we'll include the key fingerprint).

Operational ask: Rachel, please confirm the SFTP hostname (we'll use sftp.redwood-inference.com/handback/greenbridge) and whether GreenBridge prefers a single encrypted tarball or incremental daily files. If they pick tarball we'll need 4 hours to run the job and produce the TGZ + manifest.

I'll start the 24h sample job once we get confirmation.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Reliability Engineer, Evidence Delivery
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: internal_sensitivity_map_notes.md (md), export_transform_v2.sh (script)

---
From: Elena Martinez <security@greenbridge.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@greenbridge.com
Date: 2027-04-19T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity evidence + sensitivity tagging map

Rachel / Ben / Kimberly — thanks for the thorough response. GreenBridge prefers:
- full-day tarball (encrypted) with signed manifest (single file),
- KMS key id listed in manifest (to validate encryption),
- masking (not dropping) of PII/PHI fields in the sample so our audit tools can parse shapes,
- SFTP handoff to the provided path, checksums + GPG signature.

Please proceed with the 24h sample and the manifest so we can run it through our instrumentation. We'll confirm longer windows after the sample validates.

Elena Martinez
Security & Compliance Manager
GreenBridge Therapeutics
